record.question: A horse is tied to a peg at one corner of a square shaped grass field of side 15 m by means of a 10 m long rope. The area of that part of the field in which the horse can graze is
record.explanation: Rope length10m from a field corner sweeps a quarter circle within the square; area=π×10²/4=25π≈78.57m². Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
